request.title: Prove 8 statements of §10.1 (Ch10_TraceSpectral/Sec1: Sobolev norms, measures, inversion, polar Fourier)
request.body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch10_TraceSpectral/Sec1.lean` (§10.1, pp. 434–438): 8 of its 27 open proofs, no statement changed.

Closes #4877
Closes #4879
Closes #4883
Closes #4884
Closes #4885
Closes #4897
Closes #4898
Closes #4902

## What is proved

- `sIdeleIntervalSobolevMeasure_regular` (#4883): the density is continuous, so the weighted measure is locally finite; the S-ideles are second countable and locally compact, so it is regular.
- `sIdeleIntervalSobolevMeasure_invariant` (#4884): a projected diagonal S-unit has norm one (it is trivial in `J_{F,S}`), so the density is invariant and left invariance of the Haar measure does the rest.
- `globalThetaSobolev_norm` (#4877) and `sLocalThetaSobolev_norm` (#4885): from the a.e. formula of the embedding, `|g|^{2a}` times the density for `[α, β]` is the density for `[a+α, a+β]`; the norm is the square root of the integral against the weighted measure.
- `globalThetaAmbient_equiv_canonical` (#4879): uses `ideleClassTamagawaMeasure_eq_smul_canonical` (Ch09 Sec2). The constant is the norm-one class volume, positive and finite by `normOneIdeleClassTamagawaMeasure_volume`.
- `existsUnique_ideleClassSobolevInversion` (#4897): Haar measure on the idele class group is inversion invariant, and inversion turns the density for `[α, β]` into the one for `[-β, -α]`. This gives an isometric equivalence of the weighted L² spaces, unique by the a.e. formula.
- `adelePolarSubspace_fourier` (#4898): applying adelic Riemann–Roch twice gives `θ(f) = θ(FFf) + FFf(0)` for a polar `f`. Theta decays at large norm (`adelicTheta_decay_large`) and the idele class norm is surjective, so `FFf(0) = 0`. This avoids adelic Fourier inversion, which the library does not have.
- `globalThetaSobolevInversion_mem_isotype` (#4902): inversion intertwines left translation by `g` with left translation by `g⁻¹`, so it carries the `ω`-isotype onto the `ω⁻¹`-isotype.

The helpers are `private theorem`s placed directly above the declarations they serve. The measure-theoretic and algebraic cores are stated for abstract groups and spaces: in this file, unifying through the Schwartz–Bruhat subtypes or the weighted Lp subspaces ran into heartbeat timeouts (an `obtain` on `mem_adelePolarSubspace` alone did).

## Checks (commands run)

- `lake build RiemannMasullo.Ch10_TraceSpectral.Sec1` after each proof; the module builds in about 80 s (73 s before the change).
- `lake build`: passes (full library, 16 min on this machine after the module builds).
- `scripts/lint.sh`: `lint: ok`.
- `lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean RiemannMasullo.Ch10_TraceSpectral.Sec1` before and after, then `scripts/signatures.sh --compare`: no changed statements.
- `#print axioms`:
  - `sIdeleIntervalSobolevMeasure_regular`, `sIdeleIntervalSobolevMeasure_invariant`, `globalThetaAmbient_equiv_canonical`, `existsUnique_ideleClassSobolevInversion`: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
  - `globalThetaSobolev_norm`, `sLocalThetaSobolev_norm`: also `sorryAx`, only through the still-unproved embeddings `existsUnique_globalThetaSobolevEmbedding` / `existsUnique_sLocalThetaSobolevEmbedding` that their statements use.
  - `adelePolarSubspace_fourier`: also `sorryAx`, through `adelicTheta_riemannRoch` and `mem_adelePolarSubspace` (Ch02), which carry `sorryAx` upstream.
  - `globalThetaSobolevInversion_mem_isotype`: also `sorryAx`, through the unproved existence statements its statement uses (`exists_globalThetaSobolevInversion`, `exists_globalThetaSobolevAction`).

The other 19 claimed issues of the file are released with notes.
